output.summary: Programming is not supported as the driver. Brightwater concerts with and without major post-1945 works sold about the same (E7). Core, high-attendance subscribers renew at a stable 85-86% (E5), so the committed audience is not defecting. Peers that did not move lost a median 29% of ticket revenue (E10), against our 30%. Our decline came as a cliff at the 2023-24 venue move: single tickets fell 45% (E4) against a peer median of -9%. The cathedral, which is more accessible, sold much better (E11). Marketing effectiveness cannot be assessed without attribution data (E16). I recommend a segmented analysis before any contract decision and an accessible-venue pilot. Non-renewal on revenue grounds and cutting post-1945 works would be harmful.
